note: One list of the kinds of thing the bell counts as 'things need a look' (apps/web/src/routes/dashboard/attention.ts) and whether the tray (apps/windows-tray/TrayAttention.cs) counts it too. An id ending in ':' is a prefix. 'tray' is the TrayAttentionInputs property that counts it, or null with the reason it is left out. Tests on both sides fail when the code and this list disagree.

categories.whyNotInTray: Needs the browser's own reading of the download queue; the tray has no copy of it.
The summary cannot tell a job about a title from a background job, so the tray counts both in the one jobs-gave-up row.
A ready update is the blue dot, not the red one.
Setup checks are made in the browser.
Connected-app update notices are read in the browser.
